name: probabl-skills
description: Skills to support Machine Learning experimentation using the Python ecosystem.

skills.title: Explore ML Data
skills.summary: Explore the dataset before designing any model.

skills.title: Build ML Pipeline
skills.summary: Build a machine learning pipeline from the data source to the learner, including multi-tables engineering.

skills.title: Evaluate ML Pipeline
skills.summary: Evaluate a complex machine learning pipeline and get structured reports including metrics, plots, and diagnostics.

skills.title: Smoke Test ML Pipeline
skills.summary: Stress test your machine learning pipeline on future data to make sure it works.

skills.title: Audit ML Pipeline
skills.summary: Once testing and the experiment is done, audit by loading a skore report and investigate.

skills.title: Manage ML Backlog
skills.summary: Record experiment outcomes and next-lever backlog rows.

skills.title: Iterate from Skore
skills.summary: Use skore to run diagnostics and checks that can be reported and addressed in the next experiment.

skills.title: Iterate from User
skills.summary: As a user be in the loop and propose new experiments — free-text, a scientific article URL, or a resource link (GitHub issue / spec / reference repo).

skills.title: Organize ML Workspace
skills.summary: An organized workspace to keep track of your experiments.

skills.title: Data Science Python Stack
skills.summary: Opinionated one-library-per-job Python stack, organized into mandatory / user-choice / optional / transitive tiers.

skills.title: Triage ML Task
skills.summary: Route an ambiguous ML request to a focused workflow pack.

skills.title: Set Up ML Project
skills.summary: Coordinate workspace, environment, and git setup.

skills.title: Set Up Git
skills.summary: Initialize safe version control for an ML workspace.

skills.title: Persist ML Git
skills.summary: Commit the current loop stage with the real git CLI when the end-turn hook says invoke.

skills.title: Model ML Pipeline
skills.summary: Coordinate build (pytest smoke), evaluation, and audit.

skills.title: Choose Python Library
skills.summary: Resolve a library choice and add the selected dependency.

skills.title: Plot ML Figure
skills.summary: Pick pandas, seaborn, plotly, or matplotlib before writing figure code.

skills.title: Research ML Practice
skills.summary: Literature research for an ML methodology concern.

skills.title: Add Python Package
skills.summary: Add a dependency through the project env manager, or ask the user when the env is unmanaged.

skills.title: Set Up Workspace
skills.summary: Detect or scaffold the standard ML workspace layout.

skills.title: Set Up Python Environment
skills.summary: Detect the env manager, persist managed vs user-managed, and init two envs plus agent tools.

skills.title: Export ML Notebook
skills.summary: Convert a jupytext percent file into an executed notebook.

skills.title: Export ML Site
skills.summary: Initialize and build an offline MkDocs documentation site from workspace markdown.

skills.title: Export ML Project
skills.summary: Coordinate executed notebooks and an offline MkDocs documentation site.

workflows.title: Set Up an ML Workspace
workflows.summary: Scaffold an ML workspace and configure its environment and git.

workflows.title: Export Notebooks and Site
workflows.summary: Convert percent notebooks and build an offline MkDocs documentation site.

workflows.title: Model an ML Pipeline
workflows.summary: Build, smoke-test with pytest, evaluate, and audit an ML pipeline.

workflows.title: Iterate on ML Experiments
workflows.summary: Triage the loop, audit reports, and manage the experiment backlog.

workflows.title: ML Experimentation Companion
workflows.summary: A machine learning experiment companion. Focus on the science, the companion organizes the rest with organized workspaces and reporting, auditable results where you are still the owner.
